description: Search WhoisXMLAPI's domain and subdomain index for names containing one or more search terms. Returns matching names whatever their age, not only recent registrations; pass `since` to narrow to names first seen after a date. Wildcards (`*`) supported; multiple terms combine with AND, so one call covers one apex-plus-term pair. Use this to sweep for typosquats and brand-impersonation hosts, including lookalikes on shared platforms that are subdomains carrying no registration of their own. Returns one page of at most 10000 names: while "truncated_at_upstream_cap" is true, call again with the response's "next_page_token"; if no token is present, stop and narrow the terms, as the result may be incomplete and cannot be continued. "domainsCount" is this page's size, NOT a total. Do NOT use this to enumerate the existing subdomain tree of a known domain (use `subdomain_lookup`) or for typosquat verification on an already-known domain (use `typosquatting`).

domain_search_terms.description: Comma-separated domain search terms (combined with AND logic). Max 4 items. Case insensitive. Must use wildcards for partial matches otherwise the search will be exact.

domain_search_terms_exclude.description: Comma-separated domain search terms to exclude. Max 4 items. Case insensitive.

next_page_token.description: IMPORTANT: To fetch the next page, copy the "next_page_token" value from the previous response and pass it here, with every other parameter unchanged. Do not use "search_after" or any other parameter name - only "next_page_token" is accepted.

since.description: Search domains/subdomains discovered since this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

subdomains_search_terms.description: Comma-separated subdomain search terms (combined with AND logic). Max 4 items. Case insensitive.

subdomains_search_terms_exclude.description: Comma-separated subdomain search terms to exclude. Max 4 items. Case insensitive.

name: domain_and_subdomain_discovery
